name: Birthday roast reel
summary: A beat-cut birthday reel of drawn frames from the group's lore, with captions, ending on the cake.
useWhen: a friend's birthday and the chat has running jokes about them
'make jake a birthday video', 'roast reel for her 21st'
dontUseWhen: collecting money for a gift (use gift-pool)
a birthday card everyone signs (use bday-pool)
no lore from the chat: never invent stories

params.slides: 2-8 {scene: barber|pregame|parking|kitchen|beach|cake, caption, who (whose lore), tag (short name)}; the last is the cake
